text: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, he said: If one of you sneezes, let him say: Praise be to God, and let his brother or friend say to him: May God have mercy on you. If he says to him: May God have mercy on you, then let him say: May God guide you and set your mind right
